paper.title_en: Generalized Polytropic Regular Black Holes in Arbitrary Dimensions
paper.abstract_en: We investigate static, spherically symmetric regular black holes with anti-de Sitter (AdS) asymptotics in arbitrary spacetime dimensions. They are solutions of Einstein gravity, sourced by an anisotropic fluid whose radial pressure corresponds to vacuum energy, while the tangential pressure satisfies a generalized polytropic equation of state. By solving the Einstein field equations, we derive a generic class of asymptotically AdS black hole solutions and determine the conditions required for spacetime regularity. We then investigate the dynamical formation of these regular black holes within the thin-shell formalism, assuming a linear barotropic equation of state for the shell matter. Next, we study the thermodynamics of the regular AdS black holes in arbitrary dimensions by verifying the first law of black hole thermodynamics and the corresponding Smarr relation. We analyze the thermodynamic stability and phase structure of solutions in four, five, and six spacetime dimensions, demonstrating the existence of dimension-dependent phase transitions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文系统地研究了任意维度的广义多方正则反德西特黑洞，包括解的构造、动力学形成和热力学性质，研究内容深入，方法严谨，具有创新性，与主题高度相关。
decision.title_zh: 任意维度下的广义多方正则黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了任意时空维度中具有反德西特（AdS）渐近行为的静态、球对称正则黑洞。它们是爱因斯坦引力的解，由各向异性流体提供源，其径向压力对应真空能，而切向压力满足广义多方状态方程。通过求解爱因斯坦场方程，我们推导出一类渐近AdS黑洞解，并确定了时空正则性所需的条件。然后，我们在薄壳形式主义中研究这些正则黑洞的动力学形成，假设壳物质具有线性重子状态方程。接下来，我们通过验证黑洞热力学第一定律和相应的Smarr关系，研究任意维度中正则AdS黑洞的热力学。我们分析了四维、五维和六维时空中的解的热力学稳定性和相结构，证明了维度依赖的相变的存在。
